title: Real-world Anomaly Detection in Surveillance Videos
relevance: Introduces video-level multiple-instance anomaly ranking on untrimmed surveillance video.
notes: Closest foundational formulation to binary video labels with sparse abnormal segments.

title: Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection With Robust Temporal Feature Magnitude Learning
relevance: MIL, temporal context, and hard separation of subtle abnormal snippets from dominant normal snippets.
notes: Primary candidate for the next model family.

title: Exploiting Completeness and Uncertainty of Pseudo Labels for Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
relevance: Supports uncertainty-aware pseudo labels instead of treating every weak label as equally reliable.
notes: Matches our low/medium/high annotation confidence design.

title: Real-Time Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
relevance: End-to-end trainable video anomaly detection with explicit real-time evaluation.
notes: Useful for the 300-second service constraint and streaming inference.

title: Learning to Adapt to Unseen Abnormal Activities under Weak Supervision
relevance: Meta-learning for adapting to unseen anomaly types from video-level binary labels.
notes: Longer-term route once multiple confirmed violation families exist.

title: VideoMAE V2: Scaling Video Masked Autoencoders With Dual Masking
relevance: Self-supervised video pretraining that can adapt representations to unlabelled local footage.
notes: Run only after a lightweight MIL baseline because the laptop has 4 GB VRAM.

title: NVIDIA Few-Shot Product Recognition for Smart Self-Checkout
relevance: Uses an embedding database and operator-provided ground truth to improve recognition of new checkout items.
notes: Strong analogue for a local human-feedback memory bank.

title: NVIDIA DeepStream Reference Application
relevance: Modular local pipeline with decode, primary inference, secondary inference, tracking, evidence rendering, and output metadata.
notes: Architectural reference, not a model to copy directly.

title: NVIDIA Retail Loss Prevention AI Workflow
relevance: Combines few-shot learning, self-supervised representations, active learning, and actionable alerts.
notes: Commercial workflow description; use only as system-design evidence.

title: MLflow Experiment Tracking
relevance: Defines experiments, runs, metrics, parameters, artifacts, and model registry concepts.
notes: Our SQLite lab is a dependency-free local subset with an upgrade path to MLflow.
